# A pattern parameter that does not fit the expected parameter type is one
# `pattern_type_mismatch` at the pattern: nothing about a hidden binder, a `match`
# or exhaustiveness follows it.
bynk.types.pattern_type_mismatch record pattern `Item { .. }` cannot match a value of type `Other`
bynk.types.pattern_type_mismatch record pattern `Item { .. }` cannot match a value of type `Int`
